Glucose is the easiest molecule for your body to convert and use as energy, so it will be chosen over any other energy source.
Insulin is produced to process glucose in the bloodstream carrying it throughout the body.

Ketosis is a natural process that the body initiates to help us survive when food intake is low. During this state, we produce ketones, which are produced from the breakdown of fats in the liver.

The ultimate goal of a properly maintained ketogenic diet is to force your body into this metabolic state. We do this not through calorie starvation, but carbohydrate starvation.

Our bodies are incredibly adaptive to what you put into it – when you overload it with fat and take away carbs, it will start burning ketones as its primary energy source.
